correctness.rationale: Read complete proof and source-tree verification metadata. Conditional on first-update occupied vector X, extinction by second update has probability e^ΣX, since any survivor precludes global extinction and none gives no recolonizers. Given first extinction survival S, weighted transfer T=[[e,e(1−e)],[e(1−c(1−e)),e(1−e)]] factorizes local coins; trace T^ell on a directed cycle, independent product across cycles. Trace s=e(2−e), det d=ce²(1−e)², discriminant positive for 0<c≤1, e∈(0,1), both eigenvalues>0, so u_l=λ+^l+λ-^l. Normalizing by λ+^n gives factors (1+rho^ell), 0<rho<1; splitting an admissible cycle strictly increases P2. This proves one long cycle unique min and maximum as many 2-cycles as possible (plus one 3 if odd). With exactly m 2-cycles, merge gives min; repeatedly split lengths≥6 to 3+remainder and strict convexity of f(x)=log(1+rho^x) disposes of 4+4, 4+5, 5+5, proving 3s and at most one 4 or5 are max at fixed R=n−2m. Since rho(c) strictly increases, identical response on an open c interval gives identical polynomial ∏(1+z^ell); least positive exponent and coefficient recursively recover length multiset. Independently summed exact rational Bernoulli events against transfer trace for 12 network partitions n2..8 at e=1/2,c=3/4, consistency not arbitrary-n proof. P1=e^n independent network.
